g.text: Files
File
Rows
What it holds
The largest buyer names as written in the registry, with their
company group, type (company, intermediary, wallet,
anonymous, unidentified, public body, tokenization), Climate
TRACE parent and a note.
One row per company group: year, Scope 1, total, boundary,
the report's title and URL, the section the figure is in, and the
date it was checked. Only primary documents.
For every company group without a reported figure: why
there is none, and what was checked (documents, sites,
searches, date).
Official website domain per company group, used to fetch its
logo. Blank when no domain could be verified.
ICVCM Core Carbon Principles status per methodology,
snapshot 18 Aug 2026.
Projects where the three type signals disagree, so no
estimate is applied. Written by pipeline/build.py.
Possible group matches for unreviewed names, waiting for a
manual check. Never used on the site.
Registry serial ranges for the buyers published on-chain in
the demo.
